content:
Registration API শুধু একটি form submit করা নয় — এটি সিস্টেমে প্রথম পা রাখার মুহূর্ত। এখানে Input Validation, Duplicate Check, Email Verification এবং Security Testing — সব দিক থেকে পরীক্ষা করা জরুরি।

---

Positive Test Cases

TC-REG-001: Valid registration with all required fields
Method: POST /api/auth/register
Body:
{
  "name": "Mehedi Hasan",
  "email": "mehedi@test.com",
  "password": "Secure@123",
  "phone": "01712345678"
}
Expected:
  - Status: 201 Created
  - Message: "Registration successful. Please verify your email."
  - Verification email sent to provided email

TC-REG-002: Registration with optional fields provided
Body includes: dateOfBirth, profilePicture URL
Expected: 201 Created, all fields stored correctly
---

Negative Test Cases — Field Validation

TC-REG-003: Missing required 'email' field
Expected: 400 Bad Request
Error: "Email is required."

TC-REG-004: Invalid email format
Body: { "email": "not-an-email" }
Expected: 400, "Invalid email format."

TC-REG-005: Weak password (less than 8 characters)
Body: { "password": "abc" }
Expected: 400, "Password must be at least 8 characters."

TC-REG-006: Password without special character
Body: { "password": "Password1" }
Expected: 400 if special char is enforced

TC-REG-007: Phone number with letters
Body: { "phone": "abc123xyz" }
Expected: 400, "Invalid phone number format."

TC-REG-008: Name with only spaces
Body: { "name": "   " }
Expected: 400, "Name cannot be empty."
---

Duplicate & Business Logic Tests

TC-REG-009: Register with already existing email
Body: { "email": "existing@test.com", ... }
Expected:
  - Status: 409 Conflict
  - Message: "An account with this email already exists."

TC-REG-010: Register with already existing phone number
Expected: 409 Conflict (if phone unique constraint enforced)

TC-REG-011: Email case-insensitivity
Register with "User@TEST.com", then try again with "user@test.com"
Expected: 409 Conflict (system treats both as same)
---

Security Test Cases

TC-REG-012: SQL Injection in name field
Body: { "name": "'; DROP TABLE users; --" }
Expected: 400 or safely stored as plain text — NOT executed

TC-REG-013: XSS payload in name field
Body: { "name": "<script>alert('xss')</script>" }
Expected: Sanitized or rejected — NOT returned in response as HTML

TC-REG-014: Very long string in name field (500+ chars)
Expected: 400, "Name must not exceed X characters."

TC-REG-015: Password stored as plain text (security check)
Steps: Register, then check DB or reset password flow
Expected: Password is hashed (BCrypt/Argon2), NOT plain text visible
---

পরিশেষে

Registration API-এর টেস্টিং মানে শুধু form validation নয়। Business rules (duplicate check), security (injection, XSS) এবং data integrity (password hashing) — তিনটি স্তরেই যাচাই করতে হবে।

Tags: #APITesting #RegistrationAPI #InputValidation #SecurityTesting #Duplicate #QA #SQA
